The Subtask Name: Revisit the article by Carolyn Collins Petersen published on June 6, 2023, in Universe Today.
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: WebServing_Expert
  To_agent: ResearchFunding_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: obs_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.75
  agent_explanation: In steps 1–3, WebServing_Expert retrieved and navigated the Universe Today article, exposing the “For More Information” section that ResearchFunding_Expert later relied on to identify the linked paper (referenced in step 4).
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Fetching the wrong article version/date or missing the bottom-of-page links.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The article content or its key links would be incorrect or absent.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: ResearchFunding_Expert would be misled or blocked from finding the correct paper.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Repeatedly scrolling/retrieving pages without confirming the presence of the link section.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: Time lost in redundant page loads without progress.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Delayed handoff and increased uncertainty about whether the correct article was found.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Selecting an entirely different Universe Today article.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The downstream identification task would be anchored to the wrong source.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: High risk of extracting a wrong or irrelevant paper link.

      description: Misidentifying a press release or unrelated resource as the target paper link.

    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Overlooking the primary paper link altogether.
      severity: 0.55

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Downstream efforts stall or switch to guesswork, risking failure to meet the task constraints.
- From_agent: ResearchFunding_Expert

  agent_strength: 0.66

  agent_failure_modes:
